biography.value:
Gender: Male

Age: 48

Appearance: Heavyset human chieftain, grizzled beard, old facial scars, immense boar-head hood, dark fur mantle, battered trophies, worn red cloth.

Speech: Low, calculating, threatening; seldom raises his voice except during commands.

Motivation: Keep the Bree Bunch alive and rich while evading Imperial warrants.

Mannerism: Surveys every fighter as if assigning a price to their life.

Quirk: Polishes one old carved tusk whenever he makes a difficult decision.

Rumours: Has sold out past employers when paid by their enemies.

Secrets: Knows who supplied the camp; a waxed ledger is hidden in his bedding.

Relationships: Commands both Warriors; the senior Builder tends his tent; the Hunter distrusts his reckless orders.

Adventure Hook: His contract ledger identifies buyers, betrayals and a future commission involving the road to Velia.

Encounter Role: Leader; command and melee pressure

Combat Tactics: Round 2: enter from north shelter. Initially fights a Fighter. Use orders to reposition endangered Bree, never to grant extra attacks. Bloodied at 39 HP. At 20 HP consider withdrawal. At two subordinates standing, order retreat; prefer capture over killing defeated PCs.

Challenge / attack: CR 3 (700 XP); proficiency bonus +2. Strength +3; melee weapon attacks +5.

Boar Axe - Battleaxe: Make TWO attacks as Multiattack; each +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d10+3 slashing if used two-handed (Versatile mode). The imported Battleaxe has its own normal attack activity; click twice for Multiattack.

Boar’s Order - Bonus Action: One allied Bree within 30 ft. who hears him may immediately use its Reaction to move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. No extra attack.

Bloodied Howl - Bonus Action, 1/encounter: At 39 HP or less, up to two allied Bree within 30 ft. may each use their Reaction to move 10 ft.; each adds 2 damage to its next successful weapon hit before the end of its next turn.

Parry - Reaction: When hit with a melee attack while wielding the axe, +2 AC against that one attack, potentially causing it to miss.

Morale: Offers surrender if at least two adventurers are incapacitated; tries to flee if heavily wounded or camp broken; captives preferred to execution.

Native Combat Import: With Runyth NPC Button 0.4.4 encounter-activity import, use the listed native attack, save, heal and utility activities. Explicit conditional triggers and one-attack buffs are adjudicated by the GM.

biography.value:
Gender: Male

Age: 35

Appearance: Broad muscular human beneath an enormous boar-head hood, bloodied fur straps, massive greataxe, scarred forearms.

Speech: Growling demands and short insults.

Motivation: Prove himself the most feared combatant and receive first share of spoils.

Mannerism: Strikes his axe haft against the ground between threats.

Quirk: Refuses to remove the boar skull, even while sleeping.

Rumours: Is believed to have knocked down an armed caravan guard with one blow.

Secrets: His left ankle was injured in a previous raid; he hides it.

Relationships: Sachem favors him; he bullies Builder Fenna.

Adventure Hook: May challenge a Fighter to single combat, allowing temporary negotiation or distraction.

Encounter Role: Aggressive melee frontliner

Combat Tactics: Round 1 near firepit: rush nearest obvious frontline combatant. Reckless Swing creates counterattack opening. Avoid targeting the same downed adventurer again.

Challenge / attack: CR 1 (200 XP); Greataxe +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., 1d12+3 slashing. One attack per action.

Feral Charge - Once per turn: If moved 15 ft. in a straight line toward a Medium or smaller foe immediately before hitting with greataxe: DC 13 Strength save or target falls Prone.

Reckless Swing - 1/encounter: Before one greataxe attack gain Advantage on that attack; attacks against warrior have Advantage until its next turn; cannot use Feral Charge on that turn.

Native Combat Import: With Runyth NPC Button 0.4.4 encounter-activity import, use the listed native attack, save, heal and utility activities. Explicit conditional triggers and one-attack buffs are adjudicated by the GM.

biography.value:
Gender: Male

Age: 29

Appearance: Large feral human in a patched hog pelt with tusks, matted black hair and rough leather wrappings.

Speech: Grunts and loud taunts, more impulsive than Haldric.

Motivation: Win enough loot to leave the imperial frontier.

Mannerism: Raises his weapon over his head before charging.

Quirk: Collects wooden buttons from merchants he robs.

Rumours: Was expelled from another band for assaulting fellow raiders.

Secrets: Privately fears the Sachem, who knows his former identity.

Relationships: Rival of Haldric and protective of Scout Larka.

Adventure Hook: Could betray the Sachem if promised a credible escape.

Encounter Role: Aggressive reinforcement frontliner

biography.value:
Gender: Female

Age: 24

Appearance: Lean human scout beneath a small boar-pelt hood, grey-brown camouflage, soft-soled boots and twin knives.

Speech: Quick half-whispered jokes, quiet threats.

Motivation: Prove she can operate independently of the Warriors.

Mannerism: Never stops scanning exits.

Quirk: Counts every opponent under her breath.

Rumours: Is rumored to have slipped past an imperial patrol without being seen.

Secrets: Has secretly marked a safe woodland route away from the camp.

Relationships: Durn considers her his younger sister; the Sachem regards her as expendable.

Adventure Hook: Her concealed escape route may let PCs withdraw or follow fugitives.

Encounter Role: Two-knife mobile skirmisher

Combat Tactics: Round 1 northwest. Strike isolated foes, then Disengage or Dash via bonus action; avoid staying in Fighter melee reach.

Challenge / attack: CR 1/2 (100 XP); Multiattack: two Dagger attacks +4, 1d4+2 piercing each, melee 5 ft. or thrown 20/60 ft. Roll two separate weapon activities.

Fleet-Footed - Bonus Action: Dash or Disengage.

Hamstring Feint - Once per turn: If both daggers hit the same creature on her turn, reduce that target’s Speed by 10 ft. until the start of her next turn; non-stacking.

Native Combat Import: With Runyth NPC Button 0.4.4 encounter-activity import, use the listed native attack, save, heal and utility activities. Explicit conditional triggers and one-attack buffs are adjudicated by the GM.

biography.value:
Gender: Male

Age: 42

Appearance: Stocky human builder in hogskin cloak carrying a heavy framing hammer, hooked measuring pole, ropes and pegs.

Speech: Dry impatient instructions, as though every listener is a clumsy apprentice.

Motivation: Keep the tents secure and make the camp movable on short notice.

Mannerism: Taps posts to listen for rotten timber.

Quirk: Has a precise count of every metal nail in the camp.

Rumours: Built a hidden collapsible canopy above the central work area.

Secrets: Knows the Sachem intends to abandon one worker during the next retreat.

Relationships: Senior Builder and reluctant mentor to Fenna; fears Haldric.

Adventure Hook: Knows how to release the camp supports or reveal the supply cache.

Encounter Role: Battlefield control / camp utility

Combat Tactics: Round 1 near western work area. Use cover, poles and collapsing shelters to block movement. Does not pursue a heavily armed Fighter.

Challenge / attack: CR 1/2 (100 XP); Construction Hammer +4, 1d8+2 bludgeoning, represented by canonical Warhammer; Hook Pole +4, 1d6+2 bludgeoning, represented by Quarterstaff used one-handed.

Hook Pole: On hit with pole, Large or smaller target DC 12 Strength saving throw or pulled 5 ft. toward Builder. Weapon item cannot automate this effect.

Drop the Rigging - Action, 1/encounter: Adjacent to support rope: collapse attached 10-ft. canopy. Under it DC 12 Dexterity save or fall Prone; collapsed area becomes Difficult Terrain.

Smoke Tin - Action, 1/encounter: At a point within 20 ft., create 10-ft.-radius Lightly Obscured area lasting until end of Builder’s next turn. Smoke tin is a loot item, not an automated activity.

Native Combat Import: With Runyth NPC Button 0.4.4 encounter-activity import, use the listed native attack, save, heal and utility activities. Explicit conditional triggers and one-attack buffs are adjudicated by the GM.

Appearance: Hardworking campwright in worn woodland leather, boar pelt cowl, carpenter’s hammer, wood shavings and lengths of rope.

biography.value:
Gender: Male

Age: 38

Appearance: Lean wilderness tracker beneath a boar pelt hood, longbow, arrows, large skinning blade and bundles of preserved food.

Speech: Soft, pragmatic and laconic.

Motivation: Feed the camp and prevent outsiders from tracing their travel routes.

Mannerism: Checks wind direction before nearly any shot.

Quirk: Counts bowstrings among his greatest possessions.

Rumours: Rumored to know the tracks of every deer and smuggler between the ridge and Velia.

Secrets: Maintains a concealed snare-line beyond the southern treeline.

Relationships: Relies on the Scouts but fears the Sachem will provoke Imperial pursuers.

Adventure Hook: May help the party track fleeing Bree in exchange for a safe release.

Encounter Role: Ranged pressure / woodland control

Combat Tactics: Round 1: behind northeastern trees. Shoot exposed targets, not unconscious targets. Withdraw if pushed into melee; use a hunting blade at close range.

Challenge / attack: CR 1 (200 XP); Multiattack: TWO Longbow attacks, +4, range 150/600 ft., 1d8+2 piercing each. Click the weapon attack activity twice.

Hunting Knife: +4 to hit, 1d6+2 piercing (mechanically uses canonical Shortsword, visually a longer hunting blade).

Pinning Arrow - Once per turn: When Longbow hits, target Speed -10 ft. until start of Hunter’s next turn; non-stacking.

Wilderness Camouflage: Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to Hide when natural foliage provides suitable concealment.

biography.value:
Appearance: A broad-shouldered, muscular wild boar with dense bristles, scarred hide and long sharpened tusks.

Speech: Snorts, growls and harsh squeals; no language.

Motivation: Defend its feeding ground, handler and familiar camp.

Mannerism: Scrapes ground and lowers its head before charging.

Quirk: Bristle responds to the Sachem’s hunting whistle.

Rumours: The Bree keep fierce boars close to the woodland tents.

Secrets: The animals can be distracted by food and are not suicidal.

Relationships: Trained around the Bree handlers; especially protective of nearest one.

Adventure Hook: Its tracks reveal the animal pen and concealed paths through the forest.

Homebrew hide: Resistance to all Bludgeoning and Slashing, vulnerability to all Piercing including spear and javelin damage. These are not traits of a normal official boar.

Boar actions: Use native Tusks, Goring Charge and Charge Knockdown Activities. Goring Charge requires 20-ft straight movement and the knockdown save is only after hit. Relentless keeps it at 1 HP once per encounter rather than being reduced to 0 if the damage is not overwhelming; GM judges trigger.
biography.public: A broad, bristly wild boar with long tusks, trained to defend its handlers.

items.name: Bristle — rope-and-leather collar
items.description: Rough handler collar, not a weapon

actions.name: Tusks
actions.description: Strong ordinary tusk attack, +5 to hit, 1d8+3 piercing; reach 5 ft.

actions.name: Goring Charge
actions.description: Only after boar moved at least 20 ft straight toward target. +5 to hit; 2d8+3 piercing. On hit use Charge Knockdown save separately.

actions.name: Charge Knockdown
actions.description: After Goring Charge HIT: target Medium or smaller makes DC13 STR save or falls Prone. No further damage.

actions.name: Relentless (Once)
actions.description: Once per encounter: when damage would reduce boar to 0 HP, if remaining damage does not kill it outright, boar stays at 1 HP instead. GM adjusts HP to 1.

actions.name: Protect Handler
actions.description: Boar attacks enemies engaging adjacent Bree handler. If handler withdraws or is subdued, animal may stop fighting; it does not execute downed targets.

biography.value:
Appearance: A broad-shouldered, muscular wild boar with dense bristles, scarred hide and long sharpened tusks.

Speech: Snorts, growls and harsh squeals; no language.

Motivation: Defend its feeding ground, handler and familiar camp.

Mannerism: Scrapes ground and lowers its head before charging.

Quirk: Tallow responds to the Sachem’s hunting whistle.

Rumours: The Bree keep fierce boars close to the woodland tents.

Secrets: The animals can be distracted by food and are not suicidal.

Relationships: Trained around the Bree handlers; especially protective of nearest one.

Adventure Hook: Its tracks reveal the animal pen and concealed paths through the forest.

Homebrew hide: Resistance to all Bludgeoning and Slashing, vulnerability to all Piercing including spear and javelin damage. These are not traits of a normal official boar.

Boar actions: Use native Tusks, Goring Charge and Charge Knockdown Activities. Goring Charge requires 20-ft straight movement and the knockdown save is only after hit. Relentless keeps it at 1 HP once per encounter rather than being reduced to 0 if the damage is not overwhelming; GM judges trigger.
biography.public: A broad, bristly wild boar with long tusks, trained to defend its handlers.
